title: WELP website publication export
description: Public-safe derivative export (summaries/website-publication.json) that dispositions website publication for a WELP campaign and carries the fields the WumboLabs website registry/sync consumes. The website is derivative; REPORT.md and the campaign evidence remain canonical. Public-safe only: no credentials, local absolute paths, raw prompt logs, telemetry dumps, or internal identifiers. 0.2.0-draft (2026-09-12) adds the optional identity object (model/profile/event publication identity) and the optional evidence_scope field; it is a purely additive change — exports valid under 0.1.0-draft remain valid and accepted, and exports without identity remain accepted (the website registry supplies identity website-side for pre-existing publications).

campaign.description: Campaign slug of the authoritative local WELP campaign.

disposition.description: Exactly one website-publication disposition. WEBSITE_READY: campaign closed with sufficient public-safe material. WEBSITE_BLOCKED: intended for publication but blocked (missing public evidence, unresolved publication concern, or website integration blocker); reason required. NOT_FOR_PUBLICATION: intentionally excluded; reason required. WEBSITE_PUBLISHED: public evidence and website record are published and verified.

state.description: PENDING_HUMAN_GATE when the canonical public eval repository does not exist yet or the follow-up evidence has not been pushed. Never invent a URL for a repository that does not exist.

website_record_slug.description: Website Labs record slug this export drives. null only for NOT_FOR_PUBLICATION.

identity.description: Stable publication identity (added 0.2.0-draft, optional for backward compatibility). Contract: one model_id = one canonical Labs page; one profile_id = one canonical public eval repository; one event_id = one dated Records entry/evidence event. Must match the website registry entry for the same publication.

model_id.description: Stable model identity; maps to exactly one canonical Labs page (e.g. qwen38-27b).

profile_id.description: Materially distinct tested deployment/scientific surface; maps to exactly one canonical public eval repository (e.g. qwen38-27b-exl3-h1).

event_id.description: Individual scientific/publication event; globally unique; maps to one dated Records entry (e.g. context-envelope-completion-2026-09-12).

event_type.description: Open vocabulary, e.g. initial-evaluation | welp-recharacterization | profile-canonical-promotion | context-envelope-completion.

event_date.description: Date of the evidence event itself.

profile_repo.description: Canonical public eval repository for profile_id (e.g. WumboLabs/eval-qwen3.8-27b-exl3-h1).

profile_status.description: Role of this profile among the model's tested profiles at publication time.

evidence_scope.description: Surfaces this event establishes or updates (e.g. model-classification, reliability, capabilities, context, performance, serving-profile, localmaxxing, protocol-development). A later context-only event must NOT claim scopes it does not evidence; per-surface currency derives from this declaration.

record_description.description: One-to-three-sentence bounded display summary used for the website record description and index headline; no marketing language.

public_summary.description: Bounded human-readable summary; no marketing language.
